exposure: Starting dose of recombinant human follicle-stimulating hormone (rhFSH) (150 IU vs. 225 IU)
cohort: This study included 1138 patients with normal ovarian reserve undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) cycles following the gonadotropin-releasing hormone antagonist (GnRH-ant) protocol.
finding: The study found no significant difference in pregnancy outcomes between patients who received a starting dose of 150 IU rhFSH and those who received 225 IU rhFSH during IVF cycles.
